facts.fact: The AU/STATAFRIC peer review report on Seychelles' statistical system, published 17 October 2025 (review held 12-16 May 2025), recommends accelerating adoption of the new Statistics Bill to modernise the legal framework; no date for the bill is given, so the publication date is used.

facts.fact: The document is the text of the National Bureau of Statistics Act, 2010 (Act No. 14 of 2010), which establishes the National Bureau of Statistics as the principal statistics agency and repeals the National Statistics Bureau Act 2005; it was assented to on 9 July 2010 and published in the Official Gazette supplement of 19 July 2010.

facts.fact: The National Bureau of Statistics says that in July 2010 its legal framework was recast and the National Statistics Bureau Act 2005 was repealed and replaced by the National Bureau of Statistics Act 2010.
